issue.title: test_todo_background_yields_to_selection_search_yank_and_cursor intermittently retains the TODO background
issue.description: Proposed by sase-x7.3.1.5 note #4. The full test-cost lane failed once on clean 58f16fe68 after 38810 passes; final cursor overlay assertion saw TODO gold #ffd700 rather than cursor #e0e0e0. That phase immediately passed the isolated rerun plus 20 additional isolated reruns; the later clean ece5db3cc full suite passed. Land agent independently read both durable full-run records and source: the test clears yank/search then assigns cursor_location=(0,0) and synchronously checks render_line without another pause. Cache invalidation/cursor settling is only a hypothesis: establish the actual cause before fixing and add coverage that distinguishes a runtime rendering bug from test timing. Last test-source change da207ba76 is July 23; producer epic does not change this widget. No matching task or established causal global-state leak found; large size because root cause and full-lane reproduction remain unproven. Do not grow the flake baseline merely to make producer landing green.
